newsitem.title: UK: Hogg marked down after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Hogg marked down after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Hogg Robinson Plc were marked down sharply in pre-market dealings on Tuesday after the company warned that it would not meet analysts' profit expectations for the fiscal year ending in March.
At 0811 GMT, the shares were down 68-1/2p, or about 24 percent, at 222-1/2.
The UK travel and financial services concern said strength in sterling, rising competition, lower-than-expected sales and
Shares in Hogg, at their lowest level since mid-March, have slid by some 28 percent since reaching an all-time peak at 313p only six weeks ago.
Dealers said investors began to worry about the company's profits in mid-January after Scandinavian Airlines SAS said it would cut its commission payments to travel agencies.
"It was one indication that the (travel) industry was in for a tough time," said one.
